# Walmart DataVentures UI Charting Components



Chart Components for the Walmart DV will hold:


- All shareable chart components among all the UI modules as needed under Walmart DataVentures and its applications


### Developer Tools

- Install prettier, Eslint, Sass on Visual studio code

- Get vscode settings.json file from a fellow developer

### Get Started

Install npm dependencies

```
npm install
```

Run storybook (http://localhost:6006)

```
npm start
```

Run tests with coverage

```
npm run test
```

Build a distributable package

```
npm run build
```

### Publish Npm package

Chart components can be published manually from this CI looper page:
https://dx.walmart.com/nextgenci/jobonboarding/78677482-e8c3-4653-b8c2-59178643a561
